title: An Explicit 26-Measurement Phase-Retrieving Frame in C8: A Five-Parameter Family and Its Exact Boundary (Proof Candidate, Version 2)
description: Version 2 extends the explicit C8/26 proof candidate to a five-parameter family. For real parameters b, c, s, m and gamma, with s strictly between zero and one, m negative, and gamma positive, phase retrieval from any 26 distinct positive real sampling points holds if and only if c is greater than b squared divided by s. The manuscript includes the original frame, a twenty-term polynomial representative, explicit ambiguous pairs throughout the complementary parameter region, and the full coefficient argument. The conclusion is that 26 measurements suffice in complex dimension eight, without a minimality, genericity or numerical-stability claim. Reproducibility materials include both exact Gaussian-integer frames, the family and boundary checkers, a separately transcribed SymPy checker, and execution evidence. Local logical review and exact symbolic checks have passed; external expert review and proof-assistant verification remain incomplete. Substantial AI assistance was used. Paper, documentation and data: CC BY 4.0. Verification and build code: MIT. The earlier version remains available at DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22847200.
